auth.subtitle: Sign in with your registered Google account to see your finances.
auth.google_failed: The Google button couldn't load. Use a pairing code below, or reload the page.
auth.code_help: If Google sign-in fails in the installed app, open Settings > Pairing code on a device that is signed in, then type the code here.
auth.pin_forgot: Forgot PIN? Sign out and sign in again
auth.pin_mismatch: The PINs don't match. Start again.
cat.reorder_hint: Drag the handle on the right to change the order.
fund.reorder_hint: Drag the dotted handle in the card corner to change the order.
cat.merge_help: All {name} transactions move to the category you pick, then {name} is deactivated.
scan.prompt: Photograph a receipt or QRIS proof
scan.hint: You can pick several photos. You review each result before anything is saved.
scan.drop_hint: On a computer: drag photos here, or paste a screenshot with Ctrl+V or Cmd+V.
scan.tip_light: Take the photo in good light and avoid shadows.
scan.tip_full: Make sure the whole receipt, especially the total, is in the photo.
scan.not_image: This file isn't a photo that can be opened.
scan.edit_hint: Drag the box corners so only the receipt is visible.
scan.saved_for_later: No connection. The photo is saved to scan later.
scan.waiting_ready: You're online, these photos can be scanned now.
scan.waiting_offline: These photos can be scanned once you're online.
scan.from_memory: Category taken from your earlier correction
scan.error_split_part: Each part needs a category and an amount.
scan.error_split_total: The parts must add up to the total.
scan.duplicate_warning: This receipt looks like an existing transaction. Check before saving.
sched.empty_body: Add installments, subscriptions, bills, or salary once and let the app remind you.
sched.short_month_note: In shorter months, the schedule falls on the last day of the month.
sched.mode_AUTO_help: The transaction is recorded automatically when due.
sched.mode_CONFIRM_help: When due, you choose Confirm, Change amount, or Skip.
sched.reminder_help: Set 0 to turn the reminder off.
sched.error_end: The end date must be after the start date.
report.title: Financial Report {from} - {to}
install.title: Install Money Tracker
install.why: Once installed, the app opens full screen like a regular app and still opens on a weak signal.
install.ios_2: Tap the Share button (the square with an up arrow) at the bottom.
install.ios_3: Choose Add to Home Screen, then tap Add.
install.ios_note: On iPhone, the installed app has its own storage, so you sign in once more there.
install.android_1: Tap the three-dot menu in Chrome.
install.android_2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.pc_1: In Chrome or Edge, click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
install.pc_2: Click Install. The app opens in its own window.
settings.cycle_help: Set your payday. Budgets and the Month period follow this cycle.
settings.pin_help: The PIN is asked when the app opens on this device.
settings.pin_note: The PIN only locks the screen on this device and is not stored in Google Sheets.
settings.pairing_help: Sign in on another device without Google sign-in
settings.pairing_steps: On the other device, open the sign-in screen, tap Have a pairing code?, then type this code.
settings.pairing_expired: The code has expired. Create a new one.
settings.reminder_help: Schedule reminders go to this email. Leave empty to use your account email.
error.UNAUTHORIZED: Your session isn't valid. Sign in again to continue.
error.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
error.EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED: This Google account isn't allowed to use this app.
error.PAIRING_INVALID: The pairing code is wrong or has expired.
error.VALIDATION_FAILED: Something you entered isn't valid. Check again.
error.NOT_FOUND: The data wasn't found. It may have been deleted on another device.
error.LOCK_TIMEOUT: The server is busy. Try again in a few seconds.
error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
error.NOT_CONFIGURED: The backend isn't fully set up yet. See the setup guide.
error.UNKNOWN_ACTION: The app and backend versions don't match. Update both.
error.NETWORK_ERROR: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
error.TIMEOUT: The server took too long to answer. Try again.
error.OFFLINE: You're offline. This needs an internet connection.
error.INVALID_TRANSFER: The source and destination accounts must be different.
error.MERGE_TYPE_MISMATCH: You can only merge with a category of the same type.
error.INVALID_SCHEDULE: The schedule settings aren't valid. Check the frequency and dates.
error.ALREADY_RESOLVED: This was already handled on another device.
error.SCAN_FAILED_BLURRY: The photo is too blurry or the total can't be read. Retake it in brighter light.
error.SCAN_FAILED_NOT_RECEIPT: This photo doesn't look like a receipt or payment proof.
error.SCAN_INVALID_RESPONSE: The AI didn't return a readable result. Try scanning again.
error.SCAN_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: The AI scan quota is used up for now. Fill it in manually or try later.
error.SCAN_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI scan service has a problem. Check the API key in Script Properties.
error.SCAN_DEMO: Scanning needs the backend. In demo mode, add transactions manually.
error.DUPLICATE_RECEIPT: This receipt looks like it was already saved.
error.RECEIPT_UPLOAD_FAILED: The receipt photo couldn't be uploaded to Drive. The transaction is still saved.
budget.intro: Set a monthly spending limit per category. Budgets restart at the start of each cycle, based on the payday in Settings.
budget.empty_body: Pick a category below to start setting a monthly budget.
budget.editor_help: The spending limit for this category in each monthly cycle.
